title: Shared Adapter Output Schema
description: Schema for structured JSON produced by any PDF adapter (cars, codes, manuals, etc.). Owned by PDF Cars Adapter. PDF Codes Adapter must conform.

document_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this document. Recommended: sha256 hex of raw PDF bytes.

source_file.description: Filename of the source PDF, without directory path.

source_type.description: Describes what kind of document this is. Free string — adapter sets it. Examples: 'workshop_manual', 'parts_catalog', 'vehicle_listing', 'diagnostic_manual'.

metadata.description: Raw PDF metadata fields. All fields optional — set to null when not present in PDF.

records.description: All extracted records from this document. May be empty if no records were found.

record.description: One logical unit extracted from the PDF. What constitutes a record depends on source_type (e.g. one DTC block, one vehicle listing, one parts row).

record_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this record within the document. Recommended: sha256 of (document_id + discriminator)[:16].

record_type.description: What kind of record this is. Adapter-defined. Examples: 'dtc_block', 'vehicle_spec', 'part_entry', 'section'.

title.description: Human-readable title for this record as it appears in the PDF. Null when not present.

identifiers.description: Structured identifiers found in this record (codes, part numbers, VINs, model codes, etc.).

content_blocks.description: All content extracted for this record, ordered as they appear in the PDF.

identifier.description: A single structured identifier found in a record.

value.description: The identifier value as extracted from the PDF.

confidence.description: Extraction confidence, 0.0–1.0. Omit when confidence is not tracked.

notes.description: Optional human-readable note about how this identifier was found.

location.description: Where in the PDF this item was found.

start_pdf_page.description: First PDF page (1-based) where this item appears.

end_pdf_page.description: Last PDF page (1-based) where this item appears. Omit when same as start_pdf_page.

page_refs.description: Printed page references as they appear in the PDF footer/header (e.g. 'EVB-88'). Parallel to the page range.

section_ref.description: Section or chapter identifier as printed in the PDF (e.g. 'EVB', 'Section 4', 'Chapter B'). Omit when not detected.

content_block.description: A single unit of content within a record: a text section, a table, or an image.

block_id.description: Identifier unique within this record. Recommended format: 'r{N}_b{M}' or 'r{N}_t{M}' for tables, 'r{N}_i{M}' for images.

block_type.description: Type of content in this block.

heading.description: Section heading that precedes this block, as it appears in the PDF. Null when not applicable.

role.description: Semantic role of this block within the record. Adapter-defined. Examples: 'dtc_logic', 'diagnosis_procedure', 'spec_table', 'overview'. Null when role is unknown.

text.description: Raw extracted text for block_type 'text' or 'heading'. Null for tables and images.

raw_rows.description: Raw table rows for block_type 'table'. Always preserved — never overwritten. Each row is an array of cell strings.

table_quality.description: Assessment of how well the table structure was extracted. Present on block_type 'table' only.

status.description: ok = structure fully parsed. partial = parsed but uncertain, use raw_rows. failed = could not parse, use raw_rows only.

confidence.description: Overall confidence in the extracted structure.

warnings.description: Specific issues detected during table extraction.

repaired_table.description: Optional repaired/normalised version of the table. Additive — raw_rows is always preserved alongside this.

method.description: How the repair was performed. Examples: 'bbox_rebuild', 'llm_normalise', 'column_recovery'.

rows.description: Repaired rows. Null when repair failed.

image_ref.description: Reference to an extracted image file. Present on block_type 'image' only.

image_id.description: Unique image identifier within this document.

path.description: Relative path to the saved image file.

caption.description: Caption text if detected near the image.

extraction_result.description: Extraction status and any warnings. Used at document level and per-record/block.

status.description: success = fully extracted. partial = extracted with warnings. failed = extraction error. skipped = deliberately not processed.

ocr_used.description: Whether OCR was used to extract content.
